title: Rollup-aware Durable Authorized Injection DDL guard

phases.objective: Preserve strict feature-PR scope enforcement while allowing the canonical Spec 014 Integration Rollup to validate contract-local DDL content without treating unrelated Rollup files as DDL authority violations.

e2e_journeys.actor: Spec 014 durable authorized injection schema DDL guard
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Durable Authorized Injection Schema DDL Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The guard publishes a passing structured report for valid Rollup content, keeps the source SHA bound to the exact head, records the merge-candidate SHA separately, and continues to reject unsafe DDL or feature-scope expansion.
steps: Run the canonical Module-to-DDL parity test and consume its structured result.
Run a workflow regression that proves read-only permissions, exact identity routing, and separate Feature and Integration modes.
Enforce the narrow changed-file allowlist for focused Feature PRs.
Skip only the unrelated-file allowlist when the exact canonical Integration branch targets main.
Run contract-local, non-promotion, no-Apply, no-destructive-DDL, and no-provider checks in both modes.
Publish exact head and merge-candidate identities as separate structured fields.
assertions: DDL parity is derived from the focused parity test rather than the aggregate stage list.
Unrelated Rollup files cannot make ddl_matches_registry_sql false.
Feature PRs remain unable to modify Route, Server, migration, deployment, production, or provider paths.
The workflow remains contents-read-only with persist-credentials disabled and no git push.
No migration Apply, live database, provider, deployment, main mutation, or Production authority is granted.

phases.objective: This CI evidence-routing repair performs no migration, database, runtime, provider, deployment, main, or Production operation.
